name: Secure entry
purpose: Segmented one-time-code / PIN entry: per-digit cells with auto-advance, backspace step-back, whole-code paste, verify-on-fill and a resend countdown. Border carries state; the RAG signal lives in the message (mono discipline). Itinerary row 19 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 1 from the Tranche-9 OTP atom (surveyed first, per the brief).

props.name: masked
props.$note: PIN cells are type=password; OTP cells are visible text.

props.name: resend
props.$note: Ghost button unlocked by a countdown; button-family membership candidate (ADR-0013).

$states: error (border near-black; dark = red; roundel + ink message)

tokens.motion: component-type/button-family press params (injection pending conductor registration)
tokens.type: .t-cm-figure-3 (24/500 tabular) on cells — EXACT match to Tranche-9's numeral, zero visual change

behaviour.advance: Focus moves to the next cell on fill; backspace on an empty cell steps back and clears.
behaviour.paste: A pasted code distributes across cells (autocomplete=one-time-code invites OS autofill).
behaviour.verify: Checked when all cells are filled; group gains is-done or is-error; cells carry aria-invalid on failure.
behaviour.resend: Disabled for 30s; the wait counter is visible text beside the button.

accessibility.structure: role=group named by the visible label (aria-labelledby); every cell carries 'Digit n of N'.
accessibility.status: Verification messages are role=status aria-live=polite; text stays ink, roundel carries colour (1.4.1).
accessibility.masking: PIN uses native password masking — no custom obscuring that AT cannot announce.

antiPatterns: A single invisible input painted as cells (breaks per-digit AT announcement and caret behaviour).
Blocking paste (paste is the OTP happy path).
Red cell borders in light mode as the only signal (the message carries the error; dark mode red border follows the Input-fields error precedent).
Local press-physics CSS on the resend button (ADR-0013: physics arrives via the injected partial).
Auto-submitting on fill without announcing the result (verify must reach the live region).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: live form/* chrome, R-D20 error set, quaternary ladder for resend, control radius role, figure-3 composite on cells.
tokenValidation.$delta: Deliberate delta from Tranche-9: ≤480px cells shrink to 40×48 but the numeral HOLDS .t-cm-figure-3/24 (the tranche's raw 20px downshift would re-type a composite; receipt-flagged for review).

provenance.$note: Itinerary row 19 (P1), Phase-2 wave 1 worker A. Authority = _proforma/Tranche-9 OTP atom (near-canonical, ruling 3), surveyed before building; cell chrome = Input-fields state channel. No dedicated Figma node bound yet.
